title: Tech Note: Label Wizard 64-bit in 4D
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The 64-bit Label Wizard and its programmatic/JSON-driven label generation remain part of current 4D; this note is a reasonably durable reference, though newer projects increasingly favor 4D Write Pro or custom PDF/print generation for more flexible layouts.
